QuoteKG v1.2 by Tin Kuculo, Simon Gottschalk and Elena Demidova, derived from Wikiquote contributors. DOI:10.5281/zenodo.6385077. https://quotekg.l3s.uni-hannover.de/
Compilation/extract: CC BY-SA 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Modifications: English filtering, normalized whitespace/formatting controls, exact and near-duplicate consolidation, author balancing, suggested topics/ages, pagination and search indexes. Original quotations remain their authors’ words. The compilation license does not establish rights in every underlying quoted work. Existing Quotable/source-checked seed records retain their original provenance.

Goodreads source data: Abhishek Verma (Kaggle abhishekvermasg1/goodreads-quotes v4,2021-03-30) for matched numeric facts; quote-text additions from Souradip Pal (souradippal/popular-quotes-from-goodreads v1,2023-07-01); providerlabelsCC0. Historicalnumericlikes additionally matched from faellielupe/goodreads-quotes v1,2020-02-22; no new quote text imported from that unlicensed compilation. Datasetrelease dates are not exact observationtimes.

Chronology enrichment: Commonplace source-first full-catalog date pass. Reviewed work references and unverified source-context dates retain evidence. Remaining dates are explicitly recorded internal estimates, using lifespan/activity anchors where available and a low-confidence corpus prior otherwise. Author and bibliographic facts from Wikidata are CC0: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Licensing . Source wording remains subject to the underlying source's terms. Estimate markers appear only on quote cards.
